build_sphinx_docs: build sphinx documentation for pybind11 using breathe to generate doxygen xml from C++ headers
run_doxygen_xml: run doxygen to generate XML documentation from C++ header files for sphinx integration
setup_sphinx_hook: setup a sphinx app hook that triggers doxygen xml generation on builder initialization
configure_html_theme: configure sphinx html theme with readthedocs-aware css file selection for local and remote builds
configure_latex_output: configure sphinx latex output settings including preamble unicode character handling and document structure
